# FilmCraft Web

> FilmCraft is a professional non-linear video editor running entirely in the browser as WebAssembly (WebGPU/WebGL2). Timeline, colour grading, effects, audio, titles, captions and H.264/ProRes export. No installation, no account, no upload.

## Play

- [FilmCraft Web](https://elzuzu.github.io/filmcraft-web-app/): the editor, opens the demo project.

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://elzuzu.github.io/filmcraft-web-app/AGENTS.md): the `window.filmcraft` API, time model, command examples.
- [agent/manifest.json](https://elzuzu.github.io/filmcraft-web-app/agent/manifest.json): machine-readable capabilities.
- `window.filmcraft.commands()` returns the 716-command registry with parameter schemas.
- Stable control methods: `execute`, `request`, `inspect`, `screenshot`, `importFiles`, `readFile`.
